route.conditions: Current society instructions provide a subscription option with no open access publication fee; optional gold OA incurs an APC. No general absence of all publication or submission charges is established. Society states some articles require no fee, but does not identify a complete fee-free submission and publication route; online colour is free and paper offprints are optional.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Unknown; society instructions do not establish absence of mandatory submission, page, length or membership costs for the selected route.

fee_evidence.note: Society compares subscription with paid gold OA and says no OA publication fee applies to subscription.
Instructions state not all articles require a fee, and subscription articles become open archive after one year.

ISPOR instructions say not all articles require a fee, subscription articles become open archive after one year, online colour and electronic offprint are free; gold OA and paper offprints are optional. This does not establish absence of submission or other mandatory costs for a defined article type.

ai_policy.summary: The journal explicitly encourages responsible AI use and gives an example of AI-generated first drafts; applicable Elsevier policy permits research design, analysis and code development with human judgment and transparent methods. AI drafting is prohibited for Letters to the Editor, but the policy gives a first-draft example for other manuscripts.

disclosure.instructions: Journal requires a use or no-use statement on the title page and immediately before references, identifying tool, purpose and human oversight; describe research methods and analysis reproducibly in Methods.

restrictions: Authors retain scientific judgment and responsibility; AI cannot be an author; comply with applicable image restrictions.
AI use for drafting Letters to the Editor is prohibited; this article-type restriction overrides general drafting permission.
